## 1. Personal & Professional Summary

Muhammad Hamza is a Pakistani Software Engineer and AI Developer born and raised in Peshawar, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. He attended **City University of Science and Information Technology (CUSIT)** in Peshawar.

He is known primarily in the tech space for:
1. Building **Quizior** (quizior.live) — an AI-powered examination and quiz evaluation platform
2. Co-founding **Solvia Codes** — a software development company
3. Co-leading **Nexior** — a technology organization

His professional profile is at https://hamzax.me and his GitHub is https://github.com/muhammad-hamzadev.

## 3. Project Deep-Dives

### Quizior — AI-Powered Exam Platform
**URL**: https://quizior.live  
**Role**: Main Developer (sole builder and architect)  
**Status**: Live & Active  

**Description**:  
Quizior is a comprehensive AI-powered examination and quiz management system. It supports institutions, teachers, and students in creating, managing, and evaluating exams with AI assistance.

**Key Features**:
- Real-time exam invigilation with anti-cheating detection
- AI-based subjective answer grading using Google Gemini and Groq
- Multi-tenant architecture (separate environments per institution)
- MCQ and subjective question support
- Live quiz mode with real-time leaderboards
- Instant MCQ generation (up to 100 questions) using AI
- Word/Excel question import (350+ questions at once)
- Anti-cheating measures (tab-switch detection, copy-paste block, fullscreen enforcement)

**Tech Stack**: PHP, MySQL, Python, Google Gemini API, Groq API, Perplexity API, JavaScript

---

### AI UI/UX Feedback System
**GitHub**: https://github.com/muhammad-hamzadev/UI_FEEDBACK_SYSTEM  
**Role**: Developer  

**Description**:  
Advanced multi-agent design auditor. Takes a screenshot or URL of a web interface and produces a comprehensive AI-generated audit report covering UI/UX, design aesthetics, copywriting quality, and conversion rate optimization.

**Key Features**:
- 6 specialized AI agents working in parallel
- Powered by Gemini 2.5 Flash
- Glassmorphism UI with dynamic particle effects
- Stored in MySQL database
- Flask backend

---

### JARVIS — Personal AI Assistant
**Role**: Developer  

**Description**:  
A personal AI assistant system with voice interaction, task management, and integration with various AI providers. Built with Python and featuring a React frontend (KHALIFA interface).

**Tech Stack**: Python, FastAPI, React, TypeScript

---

**Role**: Developer  

**Description**:  
Earlier version of the Quizior concept, featuring multi-tenant quiz management with AI-based grading.
